text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see Hishi Amazon! She's
been on
the up and up ever since she
became a senior
racer!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I know what you mean! I'm here just to
see her
race!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I hope Narita Brian does well. I really
want to see
those two running
neck-and-neck with each other!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Countless fans watch from the stands,
eagerly
anticipating Hishi Amazon's
arrival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for the Japan Cup! Every
racer I've
seen looks tough as nails!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, don't you worry about me, Teach.
The
adrenaline is just kickin' in.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
More importantly... I've got somethin' to
do
today.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...I wanna show Brian something. See, I
was
thinkin' about what she said up on
the rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
From the sounds of it, there's someone
she's
looking to outdo, and she's been
trying to catch
up to 'em ever since.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I don't know the details. She might still
be at it, or
maybe she's already over and
done with it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
But if a rival's what motivates her to
run...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I want it to be me—the target she's
trying to catch
up to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And then it clicks. I remember something
she let
slip before...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm startin' to see what I need to do.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And in order to see that through, I've
gotta aim
high.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've finally realized why she trains with
so much
vigor.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure if I can pull it off, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Yeah, exactly!
choice_data_list: You never know how a showdown will go until you try.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm on fire today! Come an' get it, Narita
Brian!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup, a G1 race where only
the
strongest competition gather, is
beginning at last!
